body:
CI fixes pushed for both TASK-1952 PRs.
New heads: #2837 S5 856c5fe8a9; #2838 S6 690c46f058 (S5 is merged into S6).
1. task_2001 ratchet: it caught a new unrouted origin fetch that landed on main, pr_ship_batch.rs:775 (TASK-2172, #2835). I merged main into S5 and routed it through host_remote_git_command; the workspace scan is clean.
2. #2837 lib-1: every test passed, but bug_1929_store_git_guard ran 28s against its 15s time budget. Its patterns now compile once (LazyLock) and a per-site pattern is built only when the enclosing fn binds a store variable.
3. #2838 bug_2169 only_the_host_lease_makes_a_host_recorded_clone: TASK-2111 now refuses the contained launch for a forged-main seat clone (stricter than granting nothing). The test asserts the refusal; either outcome grants nothing from the forgery.
Local: aida-cli-lib targeted guards and bug_2169 tests pass (59 passed). make check-ci-compile and an aida-core re-run were refused by the cargo disk floor (14G free, floor 15G). I did not reap other agents' targets; CI compiles everything.
subject: TASK-1952: CI fixes pushed — #2837 S5 @856c5fe8a9, #2838 S6 @690c46f058
